claim.claim-text: 2. An assembly according to claim 1, wherein the body further defines a second aperture, and the assembly further comprises:
a second electrode comprising a portion within the second aperture; and a second lead which is operable to transfer power between the second electrode and the heating element.
3. An assembly according to claim 2, wherein the assembly further comprises: an air channel for delivering air to the heating element, wherein the air channel is located between the electrodes.
4. An assembly according to any preceding claim, wherein the assembly is configured to define an aerosol generation region at an underside of the porous member.
5. An assembly according to claim 4, when further dependent on claim 2 or 3, wherein the aerosol generation region is located between the heating element and each electrode.

6. An assembly according to any preceding claim, wherein the aperture comprises a first open end, wherein the electrode plugs the first end by an interference fit between the body and the portion of the electrode.
7. An assembly according to any preceding claim, wherein the porous member is a ceramic material.
8. An assembly according to any preceding claim, wherein the porous member comprises silicone.
9. An assembly according to any preceding claim, wherein the heating element is located between the basin and the electrode.
10. An assembly according to any preceding claim, wherein the heating element comprises a metal wire forming a tortuous path on the surface of the porous member.

11. A cartridge for an aerosol provision system, wherein the cartridge comprises the assembly according to any preceding claim, wherein the heating element is located in an aerosol generation region from the cartridge, and is for heating aerosolisable material from a reservoir to generate aerosol in the aerosol generation region, wherein the cartridge further comprises an air channel extending through the cartridge for delivering air to the heating element.

12. A cartridge according to claim 11, wherein the cartridge further comprises an outlet channel for receiving aerosol generated from the porous member, wherein the outlet channel extends from the porous member up towards a mouthpiece located at a mouthpiece end of the cartridge.

13. A cartridge according to claim 12, wherein the cartridge is configured such that, in use, generated aerosol passes from an underside of the porous member, past a gap located on two sides of the porous member, and then up through the outlet channel to the mouthpiece.

14. A cartridge according to any of claims 11-13, wherein the body comprises a portion of the cartridge in which each electrode is located, wherein the portion of the cartridge is a plug member which is attachable to the rest of the cartridge.
